name: abl_gearbind
description: GearBind-RankBind v7 (docs/V7_STRUCTURE_GNN_PLAN.md): a relational residue contact-graph GNN over AlphaFold structures (3 relations: self+backbone / <8A contact / kNN16) + a 3D-conformer atom-graph GNN over the ligand (bond / spatial<4.5A / spatial-kNN8), both feeding the v6 DeltaFieldHead verbatim. The score is read ONLY from the difference field D = H_coupled - H_free (prop_layers=0), so the zero-field theorem (mask cross edges => D==0 => score==b0) is inherited unchanged. Requires per-residue ESM2 (attn_pool) + on-disk structure_graphs + ligand_conformer caches. P2 run defaults: B=16, k=4, hard mining, bf16, grad checkpointing.

_notes.zero_field_invariant: prop_layers=0 keeps the exact invariant; tests/test_deltafield.py::test_zero_field_invariant_gearbind asserts score==b0 across distinct proteins with real 3D graphs.
_notes.capacity: two GNNs (JK-concat) push trainable params above the 627k bilinear default; count_parameters() printed to the manifest, capacity-matched comparator chosen at P5 (do not assert 'matched ~627k' until run).
_notes.ligand_node_input: atom_feat[39] concatenated with mean-pool ChemBERTa[384] broadcast per atom => 423-d; gearbind reads the ligand from lig_graph (ligand_encoder stays mean_pool only to supply the ChemBERTa context vector).
_notes.memory: OOM risk is the hard-neg triplet path (B + B*k forward_field passes); pinned B=16, k=4, df_n_blocks=2, bf16, grad checkpointing per the plan.
